//: Pins the exact CEF binary distribution MyBrowser builds against. Generated/maintained by build/fetch_cef.py.
//usage: make deps            -> download + verify + extract the pinned build
//usage2: make deps-update     -> resolve the newest stable build and re-pin this file
//usage3: make headers         -> download just the CEF headers (no binaries) for compile checks
notes: version/sha1 are empty until `make deps-update` (or `make deps`) resolves and locks them.
Once locked, builds are byte-for-byte reproducible: the download is sha1-verified.
Set pin_mode to 'hard' to refuse automatic re-pinning.
